pages.text: $(l)Runic Infusion$() channels the power of Botania runes in your inventory to buff your spell power.$(br2)$(l)Max Level:$() 10$(br)$(l)Type:$() Buff$(br)$(l)Botania Mana Cost:$() 50,000 + 20,000/level$(br2)The more Botania runes you carry, the stronger the buff. With $(o)runicInfusionRuneScaling$() enabled (default), each unique rune type adds additional power. This synergizes heavily with the Spell Catalyst system.

pages.title: Scribing the Scroll
pages.text: Scrolls are not crafted at a table. Set a $(l)Scroll Forge$() with $(l)Epic Ink$() and a Botany focus — a $(l)Spell Petal$(), a $(l)Botanical Focus$(), or any item tagged $(t)#ironsbotany:focus/botany$() — then choose $(l)Runic Infusion$() from the spell list.$(br2)The ink rarity sets the highest spell level the forge will scribe, so richer ink is the only way to reach the upper levels of this spell.
